_readme: The beat map for ONE video. Times are seconds on the tightened recording, taken from assets/transcript.json word onsets — never round numbers. Beats must be contiguous and cover the whole video. Kinds: face · title · ui · window · broll · cta. Delete every _comment key you like; build.py ignores them.

fixes._comment: ASR fixes for the CAPTION TEXT only, keyed by word index in transcript.json. "" drops a word. Never change timings.

beats._comment: HOOK on a real surface: the competitor's real pricing page owns the frame, the creator sits in the card with the head breaking its edge
stacked repetition — only when the line IS repetition ('every single month')
the pain word as a hollow outline in the emphasis accent; tone white for a neutral word
title stack: pill (real name) · SQUARE app mark (not a wordmark) · marker line · payoff word
THE DEMO SPINE: a real screen recording owns the frame for 15s+. Split it into several ui beats that jump to the moment each named feature is on screen, if the creator names several.
a real app window floating over the live take, with a shadow
a claim typed into the shot's real empty space — x/y from scripts/find-empty-space.py, never guessed
real b-roll of the thing, graded like the camera
the CTA on the live take; captions drop automatically
